source.raw_text:
Move Effect: Copy the printed damage of the opponent's previous selected attack. Do not copy its Kyokoro effects.
Kyokoro Effect: Reflection damage is doubled.
move_effect_text: Copy the printed damage of the opponent's previous selected attack. Do not copy its Kyokoro effects.

notes: Card identity, cost, printed damage, and visible effect text were transcribed from the supplied source.
Kyokoro outcome-orientation mapping and special-effect runtime encoding are intentionally deferred to the effect inventory / runtime pass.
Reflection depends on opponent move history and a Kyokoro multiplier; runtime mapping pending.
Reflection's base history-copy effect is executable. The printed Kyokoro ×2 effect is represented in special_effects, but exact icon-to-orientation mapping is not guessed.
